## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 is out of review and in the demo run-up: PR #418 (draggable/resizable widgets behind `dashboards_v2`, layout persisted per user) was approved by Priya and merged as `4c0e9b3`; its two follow-ups (keyboard move/resize, visible focus ring) are done on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` and sit in PR #423, still open with Priya requested. The flag is on for the Zest workspace in staging only; production is untouched. The visx migration is dead — recharts stays. (source: src-pr418, ses-db-4)

- [en-cours] PR #423 open: keyboard move/resize via `useGridKeyboard()` (Tab/Enter/arrows/Shift+arrows/Escape, aria-live announcements) and a `:focus-visible` ring, commit `8f1a2c7`, 11 new tests green (source: d4-05, ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya's review of #423, then the Zest demo on Nov 24 (source: d4-05, d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Rehearse on staging, where `dashboards_v2` is on for workspace zest-grocers (source: d4-06, d4-07)
- [prochaine-étape] Flip `dashboards_v2` on in production on the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Delete the legacy v1 dashboards (DashboardList, DashboardTile re-export) on Jan 5 (source: src-note-v1)
- [essai-raté] Wrapping grid items with dnd-kit's `KeyboardSensor`: both libraries listen to the same pointer/key events, so every move is applied twice and mouse drags fire two layout changes (source: d4-02)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries: ignored on Zest's iOS 15 iPads, everything stayed in the small layout (source: b2-01)
- [essai-raté] Finishing the visx migration: +181 KB (+52 KB gzip) for a partial move, or 9 charts to rewrite for the full one (source: c3-02)
- [décision] Own keyboard handler on top of the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Turn `dashboards_v2` on for zest-grocers in staging only; production flipped by hand on the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [décision] Drop container queries entirely, use the ResizeObserver `useWidgetSize()` hook (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Close #401 and keep recharts — no second chart library, no rewriting 9 charts (source: c3-03, src-pr401)
- [décision] Merge #418 (squash) and take Priya's two remaining comments as a follow-up PR (source: c3-05, src-pr418)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: b2-04)
